sheet_title: López de Heredia Viña Bosconia Reserva 2008 Sheet

content.title: Viña Bosconia
content.subtitle: Rioja DOCa, 2008
content.intro: Tempranillo-led Reserva from El Bosque, a south-facing slope by the Ebro. Five years in old barrels bring tobacco, earth and wild strawberry.
content.taste_note: A guide, not a measurement of this bottle.
content.window_note: In its window now. Best by 2028.
content.vintage: 2008 was a steady, cool year in Rioja, rated Very Good. A wet spring gave way to a mild summer and clear weather at the end. The estate picked from 6 to 30 October.
place: El Bosque: 15 ha on south-facing slopes at about 465 m, 1 km from the winery.
The founder named wines after French ones. Bosconia began as a Burgundy-style red.
A red Rioja Reserva needs 3 years of aging, 1 in oak. This one had 5 in barrel.
